short_description: Enterprise claims management platform with AI-powered claim scrubbing, real-time status tracking, and automated denial workflows.
long_description: Waystar Claims Management is the core claims submission and tracking module within Waystar's comprehensive RCM platform. Built on technology from the 2017 Navicure-ZirMed merger, the system processes over $3 trillion in gross claims annually for 450,000+ providers. The Claims Management module includes AI-powered claim scrubbing that identifies potential denials before submission, real-time claim status checking across all payers, batch and single claim submission capabilities, and automated workflows for claim corrections and resubmissions. The platform supports all claim types (837P, 837I, 837D) and connects to virtually every US payer. Hubble AI technology analyzes billions of historical data points to predict and prevent claim denials, significantly improving first-pass acceptance rates. Best suited for mid-size to large organizations needing sophisticated claims management beyond basic clearinghouse functionality.

faqs.q: What is Waystar's first-pass claim acceptance rate?
faqs.a: Waystar reports industry-leading first-pass claim acceptance rates, typically above 98% for organizations using their full AI-powered claim scrubbing capabilities. Their Hubble AI technology analyzes billions of data points to identify and correct potential denial causes before claim submission.

faqs.q: Can Waystar Claims Management integrate with mental health EHRs?
faqs.a: Waystar integrates with 800+ EHR and practice management systems, including many that serve mental health practices. However, Waystar is not specifically optimized for behavioral health workflows. Mental health practices should verify specific integration availability and consider whether mental health-specific platforms might be more cost-effective.

faqs.q: How does Waystar Claims Management compare to Office Ally?
faqs.a: Waystar is an enterprise platform with AI-powered features and comprehensive RCM capabilities, while Office Ally is a low-cost clearinghouse focused on basic claims submission. Waystar costs significantly more but provides advanced denial prevention, analytics, and automation. Small practices often find Office Ally sufficient, while larger organizations benefit from Waystar's enterprise features.

faqs.q: What claim types does Waystar support?
faqs.a: Waystar supports all standard claim types including professional claims (837P/CMS-1500), institutional claims (837I/UB-04), and dental claims (837D). The platform also handles secondary claims, corrected claims, and claim attachments to virtually all US payers.
